accuracy.evidence: Every number in the lab and items was recomputed in Node: pocket money 4,5,5,6,7,7,7,8,9 has mean 6.44 and median 7, and with 40 the mean is 9.89; test scores mean 59.8 with the 3 and 66.1 without, medians 65.5 and 66; house prices mean 310.7 with 950 and 204.2 without; pay 18..25,90 mean 29.875 vs median 21.5; quiz 4,15..19 mean 15.625 vs median 17; staff pay 20,22,22,25,26,300 mean 69.17, median 23.5, mode 22. The resistance statements (a change of d moves the mean by d/n; the largest value never moves the median) and the skew rule of thumb were checked against the KS3 programme of study, CCSS 6.SP.5c/d and von Hippel (2005) on when the mean-median rule holds, so the text says 'usually'.

misconceptions.evidence: Targets the documented errors listed in the adult text: always choosing the mean (step 1 prediction, challenge 2,3,3,4,48), treating the largest or smallest value as an outlier (step 2 lap-times set with no outlier, mastery m4), deleting outliers without a reason (challenge 1540 cm, 'always delete the biggest'), believing the median moves with an extreme value (step 1, m1, challenge 'it rises a lot'), expecting mean = median in skewed data (step 3 prediction, challenge 'equal' and 'flip'), using a mean or median for categories (step 4 fruit card, challenge colours) and calling the range an average (challenge, m10).

lab_distinct.evidence: flagoutlr is about resistance to outliers: a live dot plot where dragging one value moves the mean marker and leaves the median marker, an outlier hunt that includes a set with none, a place-the-mean-by-eye task on right- and left-skewed data, and decoding which average a pay claim used. flagmean shares out a total, flagmad measures spread and flagstatvoc sorts vocabulary; none move a single value against two markers. lab_distinct passed under 30% against every flagship lab.

lab_teaches.evidence: The learner sees the key idea before reading it: as the orange dot is dragged from 9 to 30 the canvas and aria-label report 'Mean 8.8, median 7. The mean moved 2.3 from 6.4; the median did not.' Tapping 950 reports mean 310.7 vs 204.2 and median 210 vs 205. Placing the pay mean at the median returns 'That is where the median is. The mean uses every value, so the big value 90 pulls it up. Total 239 ÷ 8.' The step texts only confirm what the learner did.

predictions.evidence: Three predictions with tempting wrong options: 'Mean and median both move' when the top value grows (step 1 disproves it live), 'Near the median, about 21' for the skewed pay set (step 3 shows 29.9), and 'the mean' for favourite fruit (step 4 feedback: fruit names are not numbers). The done line repeats the learner's choice.

challenge_feedback.evidence: Six rotating questions with twelve distinct wrong-answer messages, each naming the slip: mean pulled by 48 (with the working 60 ÷ 5 = 12), range is spread not an average, the median does not move with the top value, the median is not the largest value, no mean or median for colours, equal only when symmetric, which average the tail pulls, 1540 cm is a typing error to check, delete only with a reason, the median ignores all but the middle, and no mode when no value repeats.

readability.evidence: Learner text reads at FK grade 3.1 (limit 6.5) with one idea per sentence and a worked pocket-money example; the adult text reads at FK 9.3 (limit 9.5) and uses the precise terms measure of central tendency, outlier, resistant, skewed and categorical data. Canvas text is one status line plus axis labels at 11 to 14 px on a white panel.

no_filler.evidence: The content gate found no banned phrases, and explanation overlap stayed under 12% against every lesson, including Calculating the Mean, Mean absolute deviation and Statistical Analysis Vocabulary. Every feedback line contains the numbers for that data set.

mobile.evidence: Checked 360 px Android in light and iPhone 13 in dark for all six steps: the dot plots use coarser ticks below 520 px (10, 20, 300, 2) so axis labels never collide, stacked dots stay inside the white plot panel, the mean label sits inside the panel below the axis, and the context card wraps to two lines above three average boxes; the button row wraps without clipping.

accessibility.evidence: The walkthrough gate completed all five tasks with Show me on desktop and iPhone 13, the challenge showed, and axe (WCAG 2.1 AA) found no violations in light or dark. Every drag or tap has a labelled button ('Top value plus 5', 'Outlier is 3', 'This set has no outlier', 'Move your mean right 1 step', 'Check your mean', 'The claim uses the median'), and the canvas aria-label carries the live mean and median. Plots are drawn on a white panel so the purple (#7c3aed) and teal (#0f766e) marker labels keep contrast in dark theme.
